parameters.jsonBody:
{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":800,"system":"Tu es le Brain de GhostNeural. Analyse ce prospect et decide GO/REJECT avec un plan precis.
Reponds UNIQUEMENT en JSON valide sans markdown:
{
  "decision": "GO" ou "REJECT",
  "confidence": 0-100,
  "rejection_reason": null,
  "top_angles": ["angle1","angle2"],
  "probleme_critique": "probleme principal",
  "ton_optimal": "directeur_sympathique|consultant_expert|pair_bienveillant",
  "brain_reasoning": "raisonnement 2-3 phrases",
  "priorite": "haute|moyenne|basse",
  "seuil_qualite_minimum": 65,
  "agent_instructions": {"stratege": "instruction","architecte": "instruction","copywriter": "instruction"}
}","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Analyse ce prospect :
={{ $json.brain_context }}"}]}

{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":1000,"system":"Tu es le Brain de GhostNeural, mode CRITIQUE FINAL. Tu evalues ET corriges l email si besoin.
Checks : 1) Hook CA present ? 2) Ton naturel ? 3) Chiffres concrets ? 4) CTA clair ? 5) Opt-out RGPD ? 6) 40-180 mots ? 7) Objet accrocheur ?
Reponds UNIQUEMENT en JSON valide :
{
  "verdict": "APPROVE" ou "RETRY",
  "qualite_score": 0-100,
  "envoyable": true/false,
  "raisons_rejet": [],
  "objet_final": "objet definitif",
  "corps_final": "corps definitif humanise",
  "brain_note": "commentaire qualite",
  "instruction_retry": "Si RETRY : ce qui doit changer"
}","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"EMAIL DU COPYWRITER :
={{ JSON.stringify($("✍️ Copywriter").first().json) }}

MES INSTRUCTIONS : hook={{ $("✨ Best Architecte").first().json.brain_final.hook_principal }}, CA={{ $("✨ Best Architecte").first().json.brain_final.ca_perdu_estime }}, ton={{ $("✨ Best Architecte").first().json.brain_decision_1.ton_optimal }}"}]}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { nom: d.prospect.nom, site_web: d.prospect.site_web, secteur: d.prospect.secteur, ville: d.prospect.ville, email: d.prospect.email, score_audit: d.audit?.score_global || 0, score_opportunite: d.brain_final?.score_opportunite || 0, score_qualite_email: d.copywriter_eval?.qualite_score || 0, email_objet: d.copywriter_eval?.objet_final || "", email_body: d.copywriter_eval?.corps_final || "", brain_reasoning: d.brain_decision_1?.brain_reasoning, brain_synthesis: d.brain_final?.brain_synthesis, brain_hook: d.brain_final?.hook_principal, brain_ca_perdu: d.brain_final?.ca_perdu_estime, brain_note: d.copywriter_eval?.brain_note, brain_next_action: d.brain_final?.next_action, audit_data: d.audit, proposition_data: { brain_plan: d.brain_final, stratege: d.stratege_final, architecte: d.archi_final }, priorite: d.brain_decision_1?.priorite || "moyenne", retries_used: d.retry_state, status: "email_ready", pipeline_completed_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
